title: Ryan Became a Millionaire in Japan (He Didn't)

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A weak yen makes imported fuel, food and raw materials more expensive. Japan's wholesale prices rose seven point one percent in October. The economy shrank last quarter, its first drop in four quarters. Lawmakers are even debating cutting the tax on food from eight percent to one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So, what to watch. On December ninth, the Federal Reserve decides whether the gap gets wider.
